# Veritas Global Advisory

> International consulting and advisory firm delivering strategic intelligence, political risk analysis, governance advisory, and research across five regional divisions.

Veritas Global Advisory helps governments, corporations, and institutions navigate complex international environments through research, intelligence, and strategic counsel. Our practices span international business consulting, public policy and governance, political risk analysis, security and risk advisory, human rights and social impact, and research and intelligence services.
